voice.name: George - Warm, Captivating Storyteller
voice.why: A warm, unhurried middle-aged voice for the ship chandler, an old hand who knows every boat in the harbor. No other NPC uses it.

greet.text: Rope, lamp oil, tackle, paint. If a boat needs it, I have it, or I know who does.

about_gear.text: Rope by the fathom, oil by the can, hooks and line for the fishermen. None of it is cheap, and none of it lets you down at sea.

about_dock.text: The wholesale counter next door buys fish, timber and ore. The harbor master hands out day work at the cabin. I only sell the gear.

replies.dock: Who buys what on the dock?
